Joby Varghese vs State Of Kerala on 20 June, 2024 
Author: P.Somarajan
Bench: P.Somarajan
Crl.Rev.Pet No.734/2021 1/1
 In The High Court Of Kerala At Ernakulam
 Present
 The Honourable Mr. Justice P.Somarajan
 Thursday, the 20th day of June 2024 / 30th Jyaishta, 1946
 Crl.M.A 1 Of 2021 In Crl.Rev.Pet No. 734 Of 2021
 Cmp 4254/2016 In Cc 1028/2015 Of Judicial First Class Magistrate Court-I,
 Ettumanoor
 Petitioner/Revision Petitioners/Petitioners/Accused:
 1. Joby Varghese, S/O Varghese, Puthenparambil House, Muttambalam,
 Kottayam.
 2. Saju Jospeh, Sugar N Spice Bakery And Super Market, Viii/734,
 M.C.Road, Thavalakkuzhy Ettumannoor, Residing At Sky Line Hill View
 Apartment - Iib, Muttambalam P.O., Kanjikuzhy, Kottayam.
 3.P.I.Prakash James, P.I Lawerence & Company, 3,465, A & B, Pwd
 Road, Nettoor, Maradu, Cochin.
 4. P.I.Lawrence & Company, Pwd Road, Maradu, Cochin.
 5. M.Arun Kumar (Nominee M/S.A.V.Thomas Company) 17/2, Palladam
 Road, Othakalmandapam, Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu. 
 6.A.V.Thomas & Company, W-21/674, Beach Road, Alappuzha. 
 Respondents/Respondents/Respondents/Complainant:
 1. State Of Kerala, Represented By The Public Prosecutor, High Court Of
 Kerala, Ernakulam - 682031.
 2. Food Safety Officer, Ettumanoor Circle, Ettumanoor, Kottayam
 District - 686631
 3. * Director, Food Safety And Standards Authority Of India, Fda
 Bhavan, Kotla Road, New Delhi- 110002 (* Suo Moto Impleaded As Addl
 R3 As Per Order Dated 16/1/2024 In Crl R P 734/2021) 
 Application praying that in the circumstances stated therein the
 High Court be pleased to stay all further proceedings in C.C.No.1028/2015
 of the Judicial First Class Magistrate - I, Ettumanoor, pending disposal
 of the above revision. 
 This application again coming on for orders upon perusing this
 application and this Court's order dated 12/06/2024 therein and upon
 hearing the arguments of M/S.G.Shrikumar (Sr.), R.Sanjith & Sindhu
 Krishnah C.S, Advocates for the petitioners and of Public Prosecutor for
 the first and second respondents and of Smt.CHITHRA P.George, Advocate for
 the third respondent, the Court passed the following:
Joby Varghese vs State Of Kerala on 20 June, 2024

Interim order is extended till then.
